features: Unchanged Task 4 feature allowlist and shared fitted pipeline. One previous daily-mean moisture observation; no new lag features or hyperparameter search.
target_semantics: moisture_change_m3_m3 = target-date daily-average 5 cm moisture minus previous-date daily-average 5 cm moisture. Initial recursive state is the previous daily average, not an instantaneous/end-of-day reading.
evaluation: Train each variant on its training partition only. Report train/validation/exposed-test MAE, RMSE, bias, moisture/change R2, per-phase/treatment/water-event errors, macro phase MAE, clipping and unseen phases. Rollouts use actual historical weather and no observed state resets after initialization.
split_source: Use the frozen split audit memberships and explicit three-day buffer/context rules. Reject changed audit inputs and verify the membership reconstruction.

uncertainty.limits: Paired within-sequence moving date-block bootstrap on already exposed data, not independent-season or recommendation uncertainty.

checks: Report existing Task 4 validation adoption thresholds as diagnostics only. Do not choose a replacement based on exposed-test scores.
promotion: None. Keep the original saved model and all previous datasets/pointers unchanged. New artifacts are exploratory and recommendation_ready remains false.
test_status: Previously exposed observations, not a fresh independent final test. Phase-balanced evaluation mixes global chronology; chronological evaluation here tests winter wheat only.
